game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before rock golems overload Dragon Hoard Cave.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
